text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah!
Come on, Trainer!
Give it to me, set the pace!
Training with Tap Dance City again today. I instructed her to average 15 seconds per furlong, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Uhhh?
Gyaaaaahhh!!
choice_data_list: Tap, you're charging in too recklessly!
Tap, you're charging in too recklessly!

text_block_list.text:
Fine-tuning just isn't an option.
Tap Dance City was the type who couldn't be stopped once a fire was lit.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, this just doesn't sit right with me...
Even if you throw numbers at me, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Is it a mismatch after all?
Alright, if that's how it's gonna be...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, everyone, come over here!
Over this way!

Responding to Tap Dance City's call,
a throng of Umamusume came pouring in.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha,
shall we move on to the fun part?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's shuffle the partners!
Take these guys out for a run!

text_block_list.name: Nine Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to working with you~!

Looking over, in addition to the usual two,
there were about seven unfamiliar faces as well.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You never know about compatibility
until you give it a try.
We've gotta test out all sorts of things."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: If there was anyone who was a dead ringer, we couldn't call ourselves the best partners.

And so, the test commenced
against nine Umamusume. The result was—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
I understood the instructions, but my body just wouldn't...

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"As for meee...~
Numbers are totally over my head~."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa... Not a single one of these fits at all."

There was not a single person who meshed with her.
Unable to keep up with the severe instructions,
they couldn't even run properly.
choice_data_list: Maybe a more analytical Umamusume would be better suited.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay. An intellectual, huh! Then I'll
sweep an exceptionally clever princess off her feet!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea.
Wait here a second.
And so, the princess who was brought here—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Haaahn? You want me to team up with someone like this?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Though it's only temporary.
Come on, Shakur. You love 'em, don't you... numbers?”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. I'll go along with your little time-killer. But you better hand over that data you've got.

This Umamusume is Air Shakur.
From the same generation as Tap Dance City,
she values data above all else.

In a sense, someone of the same kind.
If this duo works together even better
than Tap Dance City...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm ready to run,
so call out the pace!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haa!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, figures! 14.0 it is, then. 
Alright, watch this!

Air Shakur's running was unbelievably precise.
She crossed the finish line right on target time.

Contrary to her rough personality—
Air Shakur was, to me,
the easiest Umamusume to handle.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
......Haha... I see.
I had a feeling that might be it, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...So they really do exist.
Someone who's even more of your destined match than me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...
Needless to say, the review results are—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Incompatible.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What?

Both tilted their heads at the same time. The compatibility
seemed quite good, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: There's zero value in this! Showing me numbers that are completely obvious means nothing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This won't even serve as food for the 'Parcae' simulator...
The numbers you've got aren't me, they're—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's precisely for someone who doesn't understand the first thing about numbers.
Air Shakur lets out a scoff through her nose—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you some advice while we're at it.
According to my calculations, Tap won't be a factor in the Classic Triple Crown anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you guys aren't running smoothly...
Maybe you forgot to install it.
The "plug-in," that is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Plug-in?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you just shove raw numbers onto someone
who runs purely on instinct, of course they won't get it.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I decode it—translate it, see?
Only when you do that does data truly come to life.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Later.
Air Shakur walked away with a look of complete disinterest.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, I've been thinking this for a while, but that guy...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —You're a good person.

“—I agreed. Air Shakur was the one
who taught me how to handle data properly.”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haah!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right, come on, Trainer!
Here we go! How do you want me to run?!

"The key is to convey it in words that can be
understood. In that case――"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Swoosh, float, tap...
Swoosh, float, tap, right!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text: Ooooohh...!!

Tap Dance City ran magnificently, exactly as she had envisioned.
Yes, she possessed—

Her intuition is exceptionally sharp. If so,
I only need to convey the general nuance.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Trainer...
It really hit you, loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: An anchor has dropped into both of our hearts!
And so, the gap between them was gradually bridged. And then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see...
So that's why the course you charted
was so surprisingly mild, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Yeah, everything is for the sake of next year.
Yeah, it's all for next year

text_block_list.text:
Let me explain once more the reasoning behind not targeting the big races.
Right now, what Tap Dance City
needs is not victory.
Even 3rd place is fine; just steadily rack up the numbers. Do that, and—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So it means she might still make it in time.
Even for the big races in the Classic year.

You nod. Honestly, considering Tap Dance City's
projected growth rate...
Classic-tier GⅠs would be tough. But...

"There is only one secret course.
The absolute condition is, above all, not pushing her too hard."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: You can "see" it, can't you? You of all people.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So doing that is the best option, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I see. You really are...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Ain't nobody else who could do it! Ahahaha!

Laughing heartily,
Tap Dance City throws an arm around my shoulder.
Feeling her warmth--

For some reason, the corners of my eyes grew a little misty.
I wanted nothing more than to set this big-hearted
Umamusume on the best course possible.
